items.title: Audit Phantasm Mental Illusion vs Cybernetic Optic Implants & Digital HUDs
items.details: Codified Cybernetic Optic Interaction: Phantasm affects organic mind, but raw digital HUD overlays display un-distorted feeds, inflicting a -2 perceptual disorientation penalty.

items.title: Audit Corpse Siphon Interrogation Scope on Living / Torpid Decapitated Heads
items.details: Codified Undead Head Interrogation Scope: Corpse Siphon targets ONLY deceased mortal/host corpses; living or torpid decapitated vampire heads are immune and require Mind Tear.

items.title: Audit Law of the Sanguine Tithe Hardship Deferral & Forced Draining Rules
items.details: Codified Tithe Hardship Exemption: 0-harvest weeks due to injury/stasis grant a 1-week deferral; 2 unpaid weeks allow Apex Elder forced vein draining (2 reserves) or punitive labor.

items.title: Audit Daywalker's Grace Solar Timer Drain During Swarm Pocket-Realm Shift
items.details: Codified Solar Swarm Transference Timer: sunlight on manifested swarm transfers solar burn into Pocket-Realm body, continuously burning the 3-minute timer until forced Stage 4 Torpor.

items.title: Audit Sub-Auditory Tremor Echo Airborne & Levitating Target Blind Spot
items.details: Codified Airborne & Levitating Blind Spot: Sub-Auditory Tremor Echo senses surface vibrations only; flying/levitating targets do not touch surfaces and are completely invisible to Tremor Echo.

items.title: Audit Nerve Lightning Bio-Electrical Target Scope vs Kinetic Barrier Deflection
items.details: Codified Bio-Neural Scope & Force Barriers: Kinetic Barrier deflects solid projectiles, but non-physical bio-electrical attacks (Nerve Lightning) pass through force barriers, requiring Psychic Fortress or total cover.

items.title: Audit Chameleon Facade Thermal FLIR Signature Lock
items.details: Codified Thermal Signature Lock: Chameleon Facade alters physical facial features and voice, but does not generate internal body heat, displaying as a cold blue/violet silhouette under FLIR optics.

items.title: Audit Soul Bind Incorporeal Daylight Anchor Protection
items.details: Codified Incorporeal Daylight Anchor Protection: bound spirits retreat inside their physical anchor object during daylight hours; destroying the physical anchor object permanently banishes the bound spirit.

items.title: Audit Blood Surge Single-Stat Duration Overwrite Cap
items.details: Codified Single-Stat Overwrite Cap: executing a new Blood Surge on a subsequent combat round immediately overwrites previous surge stat bonuses, maintaining a single +2 stat bonus (+2 Strength OR +2 Speed OR +2 Initiative) at any given moment under per-round expenditure caps.

items.title: Audit Visage of the Abyssal Nightmare Fear Stun Immunity Cooldown
items.details: Codified Fear Stun Immunity & Age Tier Superiority: Visage checks are modified by Age Tier Superiority (+1 vs Neonates, +2 vs Elders); a target successfully affected gains an immediate 1-Scene immunity window against subsequent Visage fear stuns.

items.title: Audit Soul Bind Incorporeal Sentry Interdimensional Detection Limit

items.title: Audit Cognitive Distortion Target Orientation & Blind Fire Penalty

items.title: Audit Phantasm Non-Biological AI & Drone Immunity

items.title: Audit Aura of the Slumbering Legion Underwater & Soil Submersion Minion Mobility
items.details: Codified Physical Excavation Constraints: re-animated corpses retain mortal physical Strength caps; buried corpses take 1 round to claw through loose soil and cannot breach solid concrete without excavation.

items.title: Define Brink of Death Stages & Torpor Eras
items.details: Codify Stage 1 (Color Fade), Stage 2 (Sunken Skin), Stage 3 (Lack of Breath), and Stage 4 (Lack of Heartbeat).

items.title: Audit Pyre Aura Underwater & Extinguishing Exemption
items.details: Codified Pressurized Vitae Fuel & Extinguishing Exemption: Pyre Aura consumes pressurized blood as fuel, burning continuously underwater, in heavy rain, in vacuums, or under fire suppression foam without extinguishing.

items.title: Audit Mind Grip Reaction Speed & Supersonic Projectile Limit
items.details: Codified Off-Turn Reaction Interception & Supersonic Velocity Bounds: Mind Grip can catch thrown weapons, arrows, and subsonic pistol rounds off-turn, but supersonic rifle/sniper rounds exceed neural reaction speeds and require pre-manifested Kinetic Barrier.

items.title: Audit Chameleon Facade Thermal FLIR Signature Masking Failure
items.details: Codified Thermal FLIR Masking Failure: Chameleon Facade alters dermal contours and voice pitch but does NOT generate body heat, remaining visible as a cold blue silhouette under FLIR thermal imaging sensors.

items.title: Audit Grand Harmonization of Vitae Severed Limb Regrowth Time
items.details: Codified Severed Limb Regrowth Duration & Concentration Math: Re-attaching a retrieved limb costs 1 Reserve in 1 round; re-growing a missing limb from scratch requires 3 Reserves total over 3 consecutive combat rounds under concentration.

items.title: Audit Daywalker's Grace Concentrated Solar Beam Multiplier
items.details: Codified Concentrated Solar Beam Acceleration Multiplier (3x Drain): Ambient natural sunlight drains Daywalker's 180s timer at 1:1 speed, but focused high-intensity solar weaponry (solar lenses, orbital mirrors) overloads sigils, consuming the timer at 3x speed.

items.title: Audit Supernatural Kinetic Crash Impact & Wall Collision Recoil Math
items.details: Codified Kinetic Crash Impact & Recoil Math: Sprinting into unyielding barriers at supernatural speed deals 1 Blunt Damage to the obstacle; if unbreached, unyielding barriers reflect kinetic rebound inflicting 1 Blunt Recoil Damage on the vampire unless shielded by Kinetic Barrier.

items.title: Audit Kinetic Crush Mechanical Joint Lock vs Internal Tissue Scope
items.details: Codified Cybernetics & Powered Armor Servomotor Joint Lock Scope: Kinetic Crush crushes external joint servomotors (locking mechanical joints and disabling powered bonuses) while passing through physical armor plates to inflict crushing damage on internal biological bones unless shielded by Kinetic Barrier.

items.title: Audit Mind Tear Foundational Bloodline Memory Wiping Prohibition
items.details: Codified Foundational Bloodline & Heritage Memory Wiping Prohibition: Mind Tear and Lethe's Touch can probe/wipe mundane memories or passcodes, but CANNOT erase or sever Sire-Fledgling telepathic compasses, Centenary Compulsions, Anchors, or bloodline heritage.

items.title: Audit Weaver's Eclipse Swarm Mass Dispersal & Partial Destruction Math
items.details: Codified Swarm Mass Dispersal, Partial Destruction & Automatic Pocket-Realm Ejection Math: Destroying swarm mass via AoE fire/explosions inflicts 1 Wound per 25% swarm mass destroyed; reaching >= 75% swarm destruction triggers automatic pocket-realm spatial ejection, re-forming a mangled torso in Stage 3 Torpor.

items.title: Audit Thrall Blood Bond Diablerie Inheritance vs True Death Withdrawal
items.details: Codified Master True Death Withdrawal, Diablerie Bond Inheritance & Thrall Cap Overage Strain: True Death triggers acute Thrall withdrawal; Diablerie inherits blood bonds. Overage Thralls impose -1 daily Reserve regen & -1 Self-Control penalties until resolved via Sanctioned Termination off Coven grounds or Coven Council Dispensation.

items.details: Codified Sacrificial Substitution blood source eligibility table: Living mortal/Thrall (250ml = 1 Reserve, standard), Vampire vitae (100ml = 1 Reserve, concentrated, subject to Coven feeding laws), Living animal (500ml = 1 Reserve, diminished), Synth-Vitae phial (500ml = 1 Reserve, half-efficiency), Fresh corpse blood <1hr (500ml = 1 Reserve, diminished), Stale corpse blood ≥1hr (Ineligible, inert).
